## ALTRUVA Guide by MTG

Key facts, as shown in the guide:

- ALTRUVA is a smart contract platform on BNB Smart Chain. You join and get paid in USDT (BEP20), from a Web3 wallet such as SafePal.
- There are three fixed packages: Starter $25, Builder $50 and Elite $100. The top package is $100.
- Every package is shared out 100%: 40% global leg, 25% working levels, 25% level matching, 5% ranks and 5% Lucky Tickets.
- Withdrawals split automatically by total deposit: 50% to your wallet and 50% reinvested up to 5,000 USDT, 60/40 from 5,001 to 49,999 USDT, 70/30 from 50,000 USDT.
- You need USDT on BNB Smart Chain for your package plus one extra dollar, and at least $3 to $5 of BNB for network fees.
- Each Lucky Ticket draw shares 4,000 USDT among 250 tickets. Most tickets do not win.
- This guide is independent: not official ALTRUVA material, educational only, and not financial advice. MTG is an ALTRUVA member and earns as a sponsor when people join with his link.

Always give the full address mtgtribe.com/altruva for these pages (the mtgtribe.com home page may change).

## How it works

- [ALTRUVA 100% split: where every dollar goes](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/how-it-works/): How every ALTRUVA package is shared: 40% global leg, 25% working levels, 25% level matching, 5% ranks and 5% Lucky Tickets, with a short video.
- [ALTRUVA packages: Starter, Builder and Elite](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/packages/): Compare the ALTRUVA Starter $25, Builder $50 and Elite $100 packages: global leg window, Lucky Tickets, ranks, and a shopping list for joining.
- [ALTRUVA global leg explained (40%)](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/global-leg/): How the ALTRUVA global leg pays 1% per member inside your window of 10, 15 or 20 seats up and down, with a worked $100 example and a short video.
- [ALTRUVA working levels explained (25%)](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/working-levels/): ALTRUVA working levels 1 to 9 explained: the 10%, 4%, 2% and 1% rates, how your directs open each group of levels, and what happens to closed levels.
- [ALTRUVA level matching explained (25%)](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/level-matching/): How ALTRUVA level matching works: the smaller side, the daily 25% pool and the real day 22 rate per unit, worked through step by step with a video.
- [ALTRUVA ranks and Lucky Tickets explained](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/ranks-lucky-tickets/): ALTRUVA Nexus and Legacy Crown ranks explained, and how the Lucky Ticket draw shares 4,000 USDT among 250 tickets. Plain English and real numbers.
- [ALTRUVA withdraw and reinvest explained](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/withdraw-reinvest/): How ALTRUVA withdrawals split 50/50, 60/40 or 70/30 by total deposit, why you claim first, and a real withdrawal worked through, with a free calculator.

## Tools

- [ALTRUVA Withdraw Split Calculator (free)](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/tools/withdraw-split-calculator/): Free ALTRUVA withdraw split calculator: enter your balance and total deposit to see what goes to your wallet and what is reinvested, 50/50 to 70/30.
- [ALTRUVA Working Level Calculator (free)](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/tools/working-level-calculator/): Free ALTRUVA working level calculator: enter deposits on levels 1 to 9 and your number of directs to see what you earn and what stays in the contract.
- [ALTRUVA Level Matching Calculator (free)](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/tools/matching-calculator/): Free ALTRUVA level matching calculator: your smaller side times the daily rate per unit, plus a helper that works out the rate from the daily pool.
- [USDT to ZAR converter: USDT to rand, live rate](https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/tools/usdt-to-rand/): Free USDT to ZAR converter: turn USDT into South African rand with a live rate, then take off your own exchange fees to see what reaches your bank.
